defects.minimal_reproduction: Create a Chromium-style dangling symlink `ln -s ubuntu-host-99999 .config/ZaloData/SingletonLock` (without JSON `lockfile`) for a dead PID `99999` and call `inspect_profile`: `singleton_lock.exists()` follows the dangling target and returns `false`, so `stale_lock_detected` is `false` and `StaleLockRecoveryManager` is skipped on relaunch!
defects.summary: macOS and Linux adapters check `singleton_lock.exists()` instead of `fs::symlink_metadata()`, failing to detect Chromium's dangling `SingletonLock` (`<hostname>-<pid>`) symlinks after a crash.

defects.minimal_reproduction: On macOS, launch 2 `NodeFixture` profiles without explicit `--user-id`: `MacOsPlatformAdapter::launch` neither derives a per-profile `--user-id` (both default to `100001`, colliding on `DUPLICATE_ZALO_USER_ID`) nor polls readiness nor reads `.runtime-pid` in `inspect_profile`, and uses `singleton_lock.exists()` which returns `false` on Chromium's dangling `SingletonLock` symlinks.
defects.summary: macOS and Linux adapters neither read `.runtime-pid` nor inject deterministic fixture `--user-id` nor poll readiness on launch, causing false `running=false` right after spawn and `DUPLICATE_ZALO_USER_ID` collisions on multi-profile `NodeFixture` launches.

defects.minimal_reproduction: Launch a profile with `--slow-startup-pre-lock-ms=3100`, then immediately call `stop_profile`: `launch_profile` returns `running=false, main_pid=null` while `.runtime-pid` process is alive, and `stop_profile` returns `0` leaving the starting process orphaned in the background.
defects.summary: Slow-starting processes (`--slow-startup-pre-lock-ms`) are invisible to `inspect_profile` before `lockfile` creation because `.runtime-pid` is ignored unless `lockfile` is already exclusively locked, leaving orphan background processes when `stop_profile` is called during startup.

defects.minimal_reproduction: Invoke `InstanceCoordinator::launch_profile` concurrently from 4 threads on the same stopped profile (`--slow-startup-pre-lock-ms=220`): all 4 threads bypass `if runtime_before.running` simultaneously and spawn 4 racing OS processes instead of serializing launch per profile.
defects.summary: Missing cross-thread/cross-process synchronization in `InstanceCoordinator::launch_profile` and shared `profiles.json.tmp` path in `JsonProfileStore` / `dim-host.ps1` allows concurrent launches to spawn racing processes and concurrent CLI writes to clobber `profiles.json.tmp`.

defects.minimal_reproduction: Start `xf-desktop-fixture.exe --lock-mode=exclusive --hang-on-quit` on a profile: `WindowsPlatformAdapter::inspect_profile` detects `running=true, main_pid=<pid>` via `rstrtmgr.dll`, but `stop_profile()` skips `TerminateProcess` because `allowed_exe` hardcodes `zalo*`/`zocr*`/`node.exe`/`dim-test-fixture*`, returning `Ok(0)` while the hung process keeps holding `lockfile`.
defects.summary: `WindowsPlatformAdapter::stop` and `inspect_profile` hardcode an executable name allowlist (`zalo*`, `zocr*`, `node.exe`, `dim-test-fixture*`), refusing to terminate hung `CustomExecutable` processes or non-matching helper children even when `RestartManager` proves they hold the profile's `lockfile`; `MacOsPlatformAdapter::stop` lacks `SIGKILL` escalation and child-tree cleanup altogether.

defects.minimal_reproduction: Create a macOS (`Library/Application Support/ZaloData/Database/_production/849777666`) or Linux (`.config/ZaloData/Database/_production/849888999`) profile where QR login happened after launch (`profile.zalo_user_id == None`), then run `backup_profile` + `restore_backup_as_new_profile`: `restore_backup_as_new_profile` hardcodes Windows `AppData/Roaming/ZaloData` and returns `zalo_user_id: None` on macOS/Linux!
defects.summary: `FileBackupManager::backup_profile` does not scan `ZaloData` for post-launch `zalo_user_id` logins, and `restore_backup_as_new_profile` hardcodes Windows `AppData/Roaming/ZaloData` when detecting `zalo_user_id` and writing fallback `.zalo-profile-id`, losing account IDs on macOS/Linux restores.

defects.minimal_reproduction: Run `create "Tai Khoan Kinh Doanh Khu Vuc Mien Nam So 1"` on both `dim-cli.exe` and `scripts/dim-host.ps1`: Rust caps `MAX_SLUG_LEN` at `40` chars whereas PowerShell `SlugifyName` breaks at `32` chars, producing mismatched directory naming conventions.

observed_evidence.input_name: Tai Khoan Kinh Doanh Khu Vuc Mien Nam So 1

defects.summary: Contract divergences between Rust (`dim-cli`/`dim-core`) and PowerShell (`scripts/dim-host.ps1`): slug length cap (`40` vs `32`), restore duplicate-name handling (`DUPLICATE_NAME` vs silent `#2` rename that can exceed 64 chars), missing-arg error codes, and empty/corrupt `profiles.json` handling (`JSON_ERROR` fail-closed vs silent empty reset).

defects.minimal_reproduction: Launch a profile, then call `ProfileStore::delete_profile(&store, &id, true)`: `JsonProfileStore` hardcodes `is_running = false` in its trait implementation, deleting `profiles.json` metadata and unlinking files out from under a live running instance!
defects.summary: `JsonProfileStore::delete_profile` (trait implementation) hardcodes `is_running = false`, bypassing the running-instance guard if called directly instead of through `InstanceCoordinator::delete_profile`.

defects.minimal_reproduction: Create profile `'Đức Công Việc'`, then create `'đức công việc'`: `JsonProfileStore` uses `str::eq_ignore_ascii_case` which leaves non-ASCII `Đ`/`đ` and accented vowels unfolded, allowing duplicate Vietnamese profile names that `dim-host.ps1` (`OrdinalIgnoreCase`) rejects with `DUPLICATE_NAME`.
defects.summary: `JsonProfileStore` duplicate-name and lookup checks use `str::eq_ignore_ascii_case`, failing to fold non-ASCII Vietnamese uppercase/lowercase pairs (`Đức` vs `đức`, `Ánh` vs `ánh`), diverging from PowerShell `StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase`.
